title: CPF Module Schema: AI Foundry Project module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-aifoundryproject'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

capability_host.type: object({ capability_host_kind = string vector_store_connections = list(string) storage_connections = list(string) thread_storage_connections = list(string) })
capability_host.description: (Optional) Capability host configuration for AI Foundry project. object({ capability_host_kind = "(Required) The kind of capability host." vector_store_connections = "(Required) List of vector store connection names. Must not be empty if provided." storage_connections = "(Required) List of storage connection names. Must not be empty if provided." thread_storage_connections = "(Required) List of thread storage connection names. Must not be empty if provided." })

capability_host_name.description: (Optional) The name of the capability host resource.

connection_principal_id.description: (Optional) UAMI object ID used for project connection RBAC role assignments.

connections.type: map(object({ category = string target = string authtype = any resource_id = string is_shared_to_all = optional(bool, true) api_key = optional(string) credentials = optional(map(string)) }))
connections.description: (Optional) Connections configurations for AI Foundry project. map(object({ category = "(Required) The category of the connection." target = "(Required) The target endpoint of the connection." authtype = "(Required) The authentication type for the connection." resource_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Azure resource to connect to." is_shared_to_all = "(Optional) Whether a specific project connection can be accessed across all projects. Defaults to true" api_key = "(Optional) API key for ApiKey authType. When provided, module sends credentials.key." credentials = "(Optional) Credentials object for the selected authType, as key/value pairs." }))

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment_blob_data_contrib.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the UAMI on storage account for connections

create_role_assignment_cosmosdb_operator.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the UAMI on cosmos db for connections

create_role_assignment_search_index_data.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the UAMI on search service for connections

create_role_assignment_search_service_co.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the UAMI on search service for connections

description.description: (Required) Description for the AI Foundry project.

displayname.description: (Required) Display name for the AI Foundry project.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Required) An identity block supports the following: object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this resource. Possible values are SystemAssigned, UserAssigned, SystemAssigned, UserAssigned." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this resource." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

parent_id.description: (Required) The resource ID of the AI Foundry account in which to create the project. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

principal_ids.description: (Optional) Set of principal IDs (user, group, or service principal) to assign the Azure AI User role.

sku.description: (Required) Specifies the SKU Name for this AI Services Account. Possible values are F0, F1, S0, S, S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, P0, P1, P2, E0 and DC0.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The ID of the created Azure AI Foundry Project resource.

internal_id.description: The internal ID (GUID) of the Azure AI Foundry project used for resource namespacing.

name.description: The name of the created Azure AI Foundry Project resource.

resource.description: The Azure AI Foundry Project resource object.

user_assigned_identities.description: The user-assigned managed identities with their principal IDs and client IDs.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Aifoundryproject' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
